name: Ampa Ltd
summary: Ampa Ltd., through its subsidiaries, develops and manages residential and commercial properties. It initiates, develops, holds, rents, and manages office, industrial, commercial and parking spaces, as well as entrepreneurial real estate. The company also engages in the Construction support, real estate financing, capital completion for projects and surplus extraction, loans for commercial properties; credit services; and leasing of residential apartment, as well as operates shared coworking spaces.
